name: feature-exploration-planning
description: Orchestrate ask-first feature intake, routed landscape research, options analysis, and feature-brief synthesis. Planning only; does not implement.

inputs.name: feature-idea
inputs.description: Prompt text or workspace path to an idea file.

inputs.name: research-mode
inputs.description: interactive, automatic, or skip; ask which to use when missing.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers accumulated across clarification loops.

inputs.name: output-path
inputs.description: Optional workspace path to write feature-brief; omit for text only.

outputs.name: feature-brief
outputs.description: Primary handoff markdown text from feature-definition-planner.

outputs.name: landscape-report
outputs.description: Research report; empty when research-mode is skip.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Remaining questions at handoff; blocking items first.

outputs.name: assumption-log
outputs.description: From automatic landscape research only; empty otherwise.
